newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH -- Cabletron started at strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH -- Cabletron started at strong buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Farrokh Billimoria has started coverage of computer network equipment maker Cabletron Systems Inc with a strong buy rating.
-- Billimoria said in a research report that Cabletron has a strong new product lineup in the high-growth switching segment of the market.
-- He said the company is expected to grow at 35 to 50 percent, which is equal to the industry rate, but better than the company has done "in the last few years."
